$comment: Reference list of credential stores that every access path to files must treat alike (2026-10-22). Not a frozen contract: a consistency fixture. Each guard (desktop path-guard, core file-gate, shell-guard read roots, system tools, Python bridge) is tested against it; adding a store here fails the guard that lacks it. A store is protected from IMPLICIT access (agent file tools, confined shell, renderer IPC); the tools that need a credential (git, aws, kubectl, ssh, docker) still run it from the user's shell, and the secrets vault injects it at the point of use.
